shloka_text: स विसृज्य ततो रामः पुष्पकं हेमभूषितम् । प्रविवेश महाबाहुरशोकवनिकां तदा ।। 7.42.1 ।।
transliteration: sa visṛjya tato rāmaḥ puṣpakaṃ hemabhūṣitam | praviveśa mahābāhuraśokavanikāṃ tadā || 7.42.1 ||
translation: सः He, विसृज्य having dismissed, ततः then, रामः Rama, पुष्पकम् the Pushpaka (chariot), हेमभूषितम् adorned with gold, प्रविवेश entered, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, अशोकवनिकाम् the Ashoka grove, तदा at that time.
explanation: Then, the mighty-armed Rama, having dismissed the gold-adorned Pushpaka chariot, entered the Ashoka grove.
comments: Rama disports with Sita in the beautiful Ashoka grove, attended by song, dance and wine, and the winter passes happily -- learning that Sita is now with child, Rama asks her wish, and she longs to visit the hermitages of the ascetics on the bank of the Ganga -- Rama promises she shall go on the morrow.

shloka_text: चन्दनागुरुचूतैश्च तुङ्गकालेयकैरपि । देवदारुवनैश्चापि समन्तादुपशोभिताम् ।। 7.42.2 ।।
transliteration: candanāgurucūtaiśca tuṅgakāleyakairapi | devadāruvanaiścāpi samantādupaśobhitām || 7.42.2 ||
translation: चन्दन sandalwood trees, अगरु aloe wood trees, चूतैः mango trees, च and, तुङ्गकालेयकैः tall Kāleyaka trees, अपि also, देवदारुवनैः forests of Deodar trees, च and, अपि also, समन्तात् all around, उपशोभिताम् adorned.
explanation: The grove was beautified all around by sandalwood, aloe wood, and mango trees, as well as tall Kāleyaka trees and forests of Deodar.

shloka_text: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागमधूकपनसासनैः । शोभितां पारिजातैश्च विधूमज्वलनप्रभैः ।। 7.42.3 ।।
transliteration: campakāśokapunnāgamadhūkapanasāsanaiḥ | śobhitāṃ pārijātaiśca vidhūmajvalanaprabhaiḥ || 7.42.3 ||
translation: चम्पक Champaka trees, अशोक Ashoka trees, पुन्नाग Punnaga trees, मधूक Madhuka trees, पनस Jackfruit trees, आसनैः Asana trees, शोभिताम् adorned, पारिजातैः by Parijata trees, च and, विधूमज्वलनप्रभैः shining like smokeless fire.
explanation: It was adorned with Champaka, Ashoka, Punnaga, Madhuka, Jackfruit, and Asana trees, and by Parijata trees that shone like smokeless flames.

shloka_text: लोध्रनीपार्जुनैर्नागैः सप्तपर्णातिमुक्तकैः । मन्दारकदलीगुल्मलताजालसमावृताम् ।। 7.42.4 ।।
transliteration: lodhranīpārjunairnāgaiḥ saptaparṇātimuktakaiḥ | mandārakadalīgulmalatājālasamāvṛtām || 7.42.4 ||
translation: लोध्र Lodhra trees, नीप Nipa trees, अर्जुनैः Arjuna trees, नागैः Naga trees, सप्तपर्ण Saptaparna trees, अतिमुक्तकैः Atimuktaka creepers, मन्दार Mandara trees, कदली banana plants, गुल्म bushes, लताजाल networks of creepers, समावृताम् covered.
explanation: The grove was covered with Lodhra, Nipa, Arjuna, Naga, and Saptaparna trees, Atimuktaka creepers, Mandara trees, banana plants, and dense networks of bushes and vines.

shloka_text: प्रियङ्गुभिः कदम्बैश्च तथा च वकुलैरपि । जम्बूभिर्दाडिमैश्चैव कोविदारैश्च शोभिताम् ।। 7.42.5 ।।
transliteration: priyaṅgubhiḥ kadambaiśca tathā ca vakulairapi | jambūbhirdāḍimaiścaiva kovidāraiśca śobhitām || 7.42.5 ||
translation: प्रियङ्गुभिः by Priyangu trees, कदम्बैः by Kadamba trees, च and, तथा similarly, च and, वकुलैः by Bakula trees, अपि also, जम्बूभिः by Jambu trees, दाडिमैः by Pomegranate trees, च and, एव indeed, कोविदारैः by Kovidara trees, च and, शोभिताम् adorned.
explanation: It was further adorned by Priyangu, Kadamba, Bakula, Jambu, Pomegranate, and Kovidara trees.

shloka_text: सर्वदा कुसुमै रम्यैः फलवद्भिर्मनोरमैः । दिव्यगन्धरसोपेतैस्तरुणाङ्कुरपल्लवैः ।। 7.42.6 ।।
transliteration: sarvadā kusumai ramyaiḥ phalavadbhirmanoramaiḥ | divyagandharasopetaistaruṇāṅkurapallavaiḥ || 7.42.6 ||
translation: सर्वदा always, कुसुमैः with flowers, रम्यैः beautiful, फलवद्भिः bearing fruit, मनोरमैः charming, दिव्यगन्धरसोपेतैः endowed with divine fragrance and taste, तरुणाङ्कुरपल्लवैः with young sprouts and tender leaves
explanation: The description refers to trees that are always adorned with beautiful flowers, charming fruit, and young sprouts and tender leaves, all possessing divine fragrance and taste.

shloka_text: तथैव तरुभिर्दिव्यैः शिल्पिभिः परिकल्पितैः । चारुपल्लवपुष्पाढ्यैर्मत्तभ्रमरसङ्कुलैः ।। 7.42.7 ।।
transliteration: tathaiva tarubhirdivyaiḥ śilpibhiḥ parikalpitaiḥ | cārupallavapuṣpāḍhyairmattabhramarasaṅkulaiḥ || 7.42.7 ||
translation: तथैव similarly, तरुभिः by trees, दिव्यैः divine, शिल्पिभिः by artisans, परिकल्पितैः arranged, चारुपल्लवपुष्पाढ्यैः rich with beautiful sprouts and flowers, मत्तभ्रमरसङ्कुलैः crowded with intoxicated bees
explanation: The trees, appearing as if divinely crafted by artisans, were similarly splendid, abundant with beautiful sprouts and flowers, and teeming with intoxicated bees.

shloka_text: कोकिलैर्भृङ्गराजैश्च नानावर्णैश्च पक्षिभिः । शोभितां शतशश्चित्रां चूतवृक्षावतंसकैः ।। 7.42.8 ।।
transliteration: kokilairbhṛṅgarājaiśca nānāvarṇaiśca pakṣibhiḥ | śobhitāṃ śataśaścitrāṃ cūtavṛkṣāvataṃsakaiḥ || 7.42.8 ||
translation: कोकिलैः by cuckoos, भृङ्गराजैः by king-bees, च and, नानावर्णैः of various colors, च and, पक्षिभिः by birds, शोभिताम् adorned, शतशः by hundreds, चित्राम् variegated, चूतवृक्षावतंसकैः with mango trees as prominent features
explanation: The place was adorned and made variegated by hundreds of cuckoos, king-bees, and birds of various colors, with mango trees serving as its prominent features.

shloka_text: शातकुम्भनिभाः केचित्केचिदग्निशिखोपमाः । नीलाञ्जननिभाश्चान्ये भान्ति तत्रत्यपादपाः ।। 7.42.9 ।।
transliteration: śātakumbhanibhāḥ kecitkecidagniśikhopamāḥ | nīlāñjananibhāścānye bhānti tatratyapādapāḥ || 7.42.9 ||
translation: शातकुम्भनिभाः resembling refined gold, केचित् some, केचित् some, अग्निशिखोपमाः resembling flames of fire, नीलाञ्जननिभाः resembling blue collyrium, च and, अन्ये others, भान्ति shine, तत्रत्यपादपाः the trees there
explanation: The trees in that place shone with various hues, some resembling refined gold, others like flames of fire, and still others like blue collyrium.

shloka_text: सुरभीणि च पुष्पाणि माल्यानि विविधानि च । दीर्घिका विविधाकाराः पूर्णाः परमवारिणा ।। 7.42.10 ।।
transliteration: surabhīṇi ca puṣpāṇi mālyāni vividhāni ca | dīrghikā vividhākārāḥ pūrṇāḥ paramavāriṇā || 7.42.10 ||
translation: सुरभीणि fragrant, च and, पुष्पाणि flowers, माल्यानि garlands, विविधानि various, च and, दीर्घिकाः long ponds, विविधाकाराः of various shapes, पूर्णाः full, परमवारिणा with excellent water
explanation: There were fragrant flowers and various garlands, along with long ponds of diverse shapes filled with excellent water.

shloka_text: माणिक्यकृतसोपानाः स्फाटिकान्तरकुट्टिमाः । फुल्लपद्मोत्पलवनाश्चक्रवाकोपशोभिताः ।। 7.42.11 ।।
transliteration: māṇikyakṛtasopānāḥ sphāṭikāntarakuṭṭimāḥ | phullapadmotpalavanāścakravākopaśobhitāḥ || 7.42.11 ||
translation: माणिक्यकृतसोपानाः with steps made of rubies, स्फाटिकान्तरकुट्टिमाः with inner floors paved with crystal, फुल्लपद्मोत्पलवनाः with groves of blooming lotuses and water lilies, चक्रवाकोपशोभिताः adorned by chakravaka birds.
explanation: The place featured steps crafted from rubies, inner floors paved with crystal, abundant groves of blooming lotuses and water lilies, and was graced by the presence of chakravaka birds.

shloka_text: दात्यूहशुकसङ्घुष्टा हंससारसनादिताः । तरुभिः पुष्पवद्भिश्च तीरजैरुपशोभिताः ।। 7.42.12 ।।
transliteration: dātyūhaśukasaṅghuṣṭā haṃsasārasanāditāḥ | tarubhiḥ puṣpavadbhiśca tīrajairupaśobhitāḥ || 7.42.12 ||
translation: दात्यूहशुकसङ्घुष्टा resonant with the calls of gallinules and parrots, हंससारसनादिताः made to resound by swans and cranes, तरुभिः by trees, पुष्पवद्भिश्च and full of flowers, तीरजैः growing on the banks, उपशोभिताः adorned.
explanation: It was filled with the sounds of gallinules, parrots, swans, and cranes, and beautifully adorned by flowering trees growing along its banks.

shloka_text: प्राकारैर्विविधाकारैः शोभिताश्च शिलातलैः । तत्रैव च वनोद्देशे वैडूर्यमणिसन्निभैः ।। 7.42.13 ।।
transliteration: prākārairvividhākāraiḥ śobhitāśca śilātalaiḥ | tatraiva ca vanoddeśe vaiḍūryamaṇisannibhaiḥ || 7.42.13 ||
translation: प्राकारैः by enclosures, विविधाकारैः of various forms, शोभिताश्च and adorned, शिलातलैः by rock surfaces, तत्रैव there indeed, च and, वनोद्देशे in that part of the forest, वैडूर्यमणिसन्निभैः resembling lapis lazuli gems.
explanation: The area was embellished with diverse enclosures and rock surfaces, and within that forest region, there were spots that shimmered like lapis lazuli gems.

shloka_text: शाद्वलैः परमोपेतां पुष्पितद्रुमकाननाम् । तत्र सङ्घर्षजातानां वृक्षाणां पुष्पशालिनाम् ।। 7.42.14 ।।
transliteration: śādvalaiḥ paramopetāṃ puṣpitadrumakānanām | tatra saṅgharṣajātānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ puṣpaśālinām || 7.42.14 ||
translation: शाद्वलैः by green meadows, परमोपेतां supremely endowed, पुष्पितद्रुमकाननाम् with groves of flowering trees, तत्र there, सङ्घर्षजातानां grown from close proximity, वृक्षाणां of trees, पुष्पशालिनाम् adorned with flowers.
explanation: It was supremely rich with green meadows and flowering tree groves, where trees growing in close proximity were resplendent with blossoms.

shloka_text: प्रस्तराः पुष्पशबला नभस्तारागणैरिव । नन्दनं हि यथेन्द्रस्य ब्राह्मं चैत्ररथं यथा ।। 7.42.15 ।।
transliteration: prastarāḥ puṣpaśabalā nabhastārāgaṇairiva | nandanaṃ hi yathendrasya brāhmaṃ caitrarathaṃ yathā | tathābhūtaṃ hi rāmasya kānanaṃ sanniveśanam || 7.42.15 ||
translation: प्रस्तराः the rock surfaces, पुष्पशबला variegated with flowers, नभः the sky, तारागणैः by clusters of stars, इव as if, नन्दनं Nandana, हि indeed, यथा just as, इन्द्रस्य of Indra, ब्राह्मं of Brahma, चैत्ररथं Chaitraratha, यथा just as, तथाभूतं such, हि indeed, रामस्य of Rama, काननं the garden, सन्निवेशनाम् the dwelling/setting.
explanation: The rock surfaces were variegated with flowers, resembling the sky adorned with clusters of stars, and indeed, Rama's garden and dwelling were as magnificent as Indra's Nandana or Kubera's Chaitraratha.

shloka_text: तथाभूतं हि रामस्य काननं सन्निवेशनम् । बह्वासनगृहोपेतां लतागृहसमावृताम् ।। 7.42.16 ।।
transliteration: bahvāsanagṛhopetāṃ latāgṛhasamāvṛtām | aśokavanikāṃ sphītāṃ praviśya raghunandanaḥ || 7.42.16 ||
translation: तथाभूतं such, हि indeed, रामस्य of Rama, काननं garden, सन्निवेशनम् dwelling, बह्वासनगृहोपेतां endowed with many seats and houses, लतागृहसमावृताम् surrounded by creeper-houses.
explanation: Indeed, such was Rama's dwelling garden, adorned with numerous seats and pavilions, and enveloped by charming creeper-houses.

shloka_text: अशोकवनिकां स्फीतां प्रविश्य रघुनन्दनः । आसने च शुभाकारे पुष्पप्रकरभूषिते ।। 7.42.17 ।।
transliteration: āsane ca śubhākāre puṣpaprakarabhūṣite | kuśāstaraṇasaṃstīrṇe rāmaḥ sanniṣasāda ha || 7.42.17 ||
translation: अशोकवनिकां into the Ashoka grove, स्फीतां extensive, प्रविश्य having entered, रघुनन्दनः Rama, the delight of the Raghus, आसने on a seat, च and, शुभाकारे of beautiful form, पुष्पप्रकरभूषिते adorned with heaps of flowers.
explanation: Having entered the extensive Ashoka grove, Rama, the delight of the Raghus, found a beautifully shaped seat adorned with heaps of flowers.

shloka_text: कुशास्तरणसंस्तीर्णे रामः सन्निषसाद ह । सीतामादायं हस्तेन मधुमैरेयकं शुचि ।। 7.42.18 ।।
transliteration: sītāmādāyaṃ hastena madhumaireyakaṃ śuci | pāyayāmāsa kākutsthaḥ śacīmiva purandaraḥ || 7.42.18 ||
translation: कुशास्तरणसंस्तीर्णे spread with a mat of Kusa grass, रामः Rama, सन्निषसाद sat down, ह indeed, सीतामादायं taking Sita, हस्तेन by the hand, मधुमैरेयकं the wine called Madhu-Maireyaka, शुचि pure.
explanation: Rama indeed sat down on the seat, which was spread with a mat of Kusa grass, and with Sita by his hand, he had the pure Madhu-Maireyaka wine ready.

shloka_text: पाययामास काकुत्स्थः शचीमिव पुरन्दरः । मांसानि च समृष्टानि फलानि विविधानि च ।। 7.42.19 ।।
transliteration: māṃsāni ca samṛṣṭāni phalāni vividhāni ca | rāmasyābhyavahārārthaṃ kiṅkarāstūrṇamāharan || 7.42.19 ||
translation: पाययामास made to drink, काकुत्स्थः Rama, शचीमिव like Shachi, पुरन्दरः Indra, मांसानि meats, च and, समृष्टानि well-prepared, फलानि fruits, विविधानि various, च and.
explanation: Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, made her drink, just as Indra makes Shachi drink, and there were well-prepared meats and various fruits.

shloka_text: रामस्याभ्यवहारार्थं किङ्करास्तूर्णमाहरन्उ । उपानृत्यंश्च राजानं नृत्यगीतविशारदाः ।। 7.42.20 ।।
transliteration: upānṛtyaṃśca rājānaṃ nṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ | bālāśca rūpavatyaśca striyaḥ pānavaśānugāḥ || 7.42.20 ||
translation: रामस्याभ्यवहारार्थं for Rama's meal, किङ्कराः servants, तूर्णम् quickly, आहरन् brought, उपानृत्यंश्च and danced before, राजानं the king, नृत्यगीतविशारदाः skilled in dance and song.
explanation: Servants quickly brought food for Rama's meal, and those skilled in dance and song performed before the king.

shloka_text: बालाश्च रूपवत्यश्च स्त्रियः पानवशानुगाः । मनोभिरामा रामास्ता रामो रमयतां वरः ।। 7.42.21 ।।
transliteration: manobhirāmā rāmāstā rāmo ramayatāṃ varaḥ | ramayāmāsa dharmātmā nityaṃ paramabhūṣitaḥ || 7.42.21 ||
translation: बालाः young, च and, रूपवत्यः beautiful, च and, स्त्रियः women, पानवशानुगाः subservient to drink, मनोभिरामाः charming, रामाः women, ताः those, रामः Rama, रमयतां among those who delight, वरः the best.
explanation: Rama, the best among those who delight, was in the company of young, beautiful, and charming women who were under the influence of drink.

shloka_text: उपानृत्यन्त काकुत्स्थं नृत्यगीतविशारदाः । मनोभिरामा रामास्ता रामो रमयतां वरः ।। 7.42.22 ।।
transliteration: sa tayā sītayā sārdhamāsīno virarāja ha | arundhatyā sahāsīno vasiṣṭha iva tejasā || 7.42.22 ||
translation: उपानृत्यन्त danced before, काकुत्स्थम् Kakutstha (Rama), नृत्यगीतविशारदाः skilled in dance and song, मनोभिरामाः charming, रामाः women, ताः those, रामः Rama, रमयतां among those who delight, वरः the best.
explanation: Skilled in dance and song, charming women danced before Rama, the best among those who delight.

shloka_text: रमयामास धर्मात्मा नित्यं परमभूषितः । स तया सीतया सार्धमासीनो विरराज ह ।। 7.42.23 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ rāmo mudā yuktaḥ sītāṃ surasutopamām | ramayāmāsa vaidehīmahanyahani devavat || 7.42.23 ||
translation: रमयामास he delighted, धर्मात्मा the righteous soul (Rama), नित्यम् always, परमभूषितः highly adorned, सः he, तया with her, सीतया Sita, सार्धम् together with, आसीनः seated, विरराज shone, ह indeed.
explanation: The righteous Rama, always highly adorned, delighted (them), and he shone splendidly while seated with Sita.

shloka_text: अरुन्धत्या सहासीनो वसिष्ठ इव तेजसा । एवं रामो मुदा युक्तः सीतां सुरसुतोपमाम् ।। 7.42.24 ।।
transliteration: tathā tayorviharatoḥ sītārāghavayościram | atyakrāmacchubhaḥ kālaḥ śaiśiro bhogadaḥ sadā || 7.42.24 ||
translation: अरुन्धत्या with Arundhati, सह with, आसीनः seated, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, इव like, तेजसा with splendor, एवम् thus, रामः Rama, मुदा with joy, युक्तः endowed, सीताम् Sita, सुरसुतोपमाम् resembling a celestial nymph.
explanation: Rama, filled with joy, thus shone with splendor like Vasishtha seated with Arundhati, with Sita resembling a celestial nymph.

shloka_text: रमयामास वैदेहीमहन्यहनि देववत्त । था तयोर्विहरतोः सीताराघवयोश्चिरम् ।। 7.42.25 ।।
transliteration: daśavarṣasahasrāṇi gatāni sumahātmanoḥ | prāptayorvividhānbhogānatītaḥ śiśirāgamaḥ || 7.42.25 ||
translation: रमयामास he delighted, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi (Sita), अहन्यहनि day after day, देववत् like a god, तथा thus, तयोः of those two, विहरतोः while sporting, सीताराघवयोः of Sita and Raghava, चिरम् for a long time.
explanation: Rama, like a god, delighted Sita day after day, and thus Sita and Raghava sported together for a long time.

shloka_text: अत्यक्रामच्छुभः कालः शैशिरो भोगदः सदा । प्राप्तयोर्विविधान्भोगानतीतः शिशिरागमः ।। 7.42.26 ।।
transliteration: pūrvāhṇe dharmakāryāṇi kṛtvā dharmeṇa dharmavit | śeṣaṃ divasabhāgārdhamantaḥpuragato 'bhavat || 7.42.26 ||
translation: अत्यक्रामत् passed away, शुभः auspicious, कालः time, शैशिरः winter, भोगदः giving enjoyment, सदा always, प्राप्तयोः for the two who had obtained, विविधान् various, भोगान् enjoyments, अतीतः passed, शिशिरागमः winter season.
explanation: The auspicious and always pleasure-giving winter season, during which Rama and Sita had enjoyed various pleasures, passed away.

shloka_text: पूर्वाह्णे धर्मकार्याणि कृत्वा धर्मेण धर्मवित् । शेषं दिवसभागार्धमन्तःपुरगतो ऽभवत् ।। 7.42.27 ।।
transliteration: sītāpi devakāryāṇi kṛtvā paurvāhṇikāni vai | śvaśrūṇāmakarotpūjāṃ sarvāsāmaviśeṣataḥ || 7.42.27 ||
translation: पूर्वाह्णे in the forenoon, धर्मकार्याणि religious duties, कृत्वा having done, धर्मेण righteously, धर्मवित् the knower of dharma, शेषं the remaining, दिवसभागार्धम् half of the day's portion, अन्तःपुरगतः gone to the inner apartments, अभवत् became.
explanation: Having performed his religious duties righteously in the forenoon, the knower of dharma, Rama, spent the remaining half of the day in his inner apartments.

shloka_text: सीतापि देवकार्याणि कृत्वा पौर्वाह्णिकानि वै । श्वश्रूणामकरोत्पूजां सर्वासामविशेषतः ।। 7.42.28 ।।
transliteration: abhyagacchattato rāmaṃ vicitrābharaṇāmbarā | triviṣṭape sahasrākṣamupaviṣṭaṃ yathā śacī || 7.42.28 ||
translation: सीतापि Sita also, देवकार्याणि divine duties, कृत्वा having done, पौर्वाह्णिकानि morning, वै indeed, श्वश्रूणाम् of the mothers-in-law, अकरोत् performed, पूजां reverence, सर्वासाम् of all, अविशेषतः without distinction.
explanation: Sita also, having performed her morning divine duties, reverently honored all her mothers-in-law without any distinction.

shloka_text: अभ्यगच्छत्ततो रामं विचित्राभरणाम्बरा । त्रिविष्टपे सहस्राक्षमुपविष्टं यथा शची ।। 7.42.29 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tu rāghavaḥ patnīṃ kalyāṇena samanvitām | praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe sādhu sādhviti cābravīt || 7.42.29 ||
translation: अभ्यगच्छत् approached, ततः then, रामं Rama, विचित्राभरणाम्बरा adorned with various ornaments and garments, त्रिविष्टपे in heaven, सहस्राक्षम् the thousand-eyed one, उपविष्टं seated, यथा just as, शची Shachi.
explanation: Then, adorned with various ornaments and garments, Sita approached Rama, just as Shachi approaches the thousand-eyed Indra seated in heaven.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा तु राघवः पत्नीं कल्याणेन समन्विताम् । प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे साधु साध्विति चाब्रवीत् ।। 7.42.30 ।।
transliteration: abravīcca varārohāṃ sītāṃ surasutopamām | apatyalābho vaidehi tvayi me samupasthitaḥ || 7.42.30 ||
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, तु indeed, राघवः Rama, पत्नीं wife, कल्याणेन with auspiciousness, समन्विताम् endowed, प्रहर्षम् great joy, अतुलं incomparable, लेभे obtained, साधु excellent, साधु excellent, इति thus, च and, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Having seen his wife, Sita, endowed with auspiciousness, Rama felt incomparable joy and exclaimed, "Excellent, excellent!"

shloka_text: अब्रवीच्च वरारोहां सीतां सुरसुतोपमाम् । अपत्यलाभो वैदेहि त्वयि मे समुपस्थितः ।। 7.42.31 ।।
transliteration: kimicchasi varārohe kāmaḥ kiṃ kriyatāṃ tava || 7.42.31 ||
translation: अब्रवीत् said, च and, वरारोहां to the one with beautiful thighs, सीतां Sita, सुरसुतोपमाम् who was like a daughter of a god, अपत्यलाभः the gain of offspring, वैदेहि O Vaidehi, त्वयि in you, मे to me, समुपस्थितः has come.
explanation: Rama said to Sita, who had beautiful thighs and resembled a divine daughter, "O Vaidehi, the blessing of progeny has come to me through you."

shloka_text: किमिच्छसि वरारोहे कामः किं क्रियतां तव । स्मितं कृत्वा तु वैदेही रामं वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।। 7.42.32 ।।
transliteration: smitaṃ kṛtvā tu vaidehī rāmaṃ vākyamathābravīt | tapovanāni puṇyāni draṣṭumicchāmi rāghava || 7.42.32 ||
translation: किम् what, इच्छसि do you desire, वरारोहे O one with beautiful thighs, कामः desire, किम् what, क्रियताम् may be done, तव for you, स्मितं smile, कृत्वा having made, तु indeed, वैदेही Vaidehi, रामं to Rama, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Rama asked Sita, "O one with beautiful thighs, what do you desire? What wish of yours may I fulfill?" Then, smiling, Vaidehi spoke these words to Rama.

shloka_text: तपोवनानि पुण्यानि द्रष्टुमिच्छामि राघव । गङ्गातीरोपविष्टानामृषीणामुग्रतेजसाम् ।। 7.42.33 ।।
transliteration: gaṅgātīropaviṣṭānāmṛṣīṇāmugratejasām | phalamūlāśināṃ deva pādamūleṣu vartitum || 7.42.33 ||
translation: तपोवनानि hermitages, पुण्यानि sacred, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि I desire, राघव O Raghava, गङ्गातीरोपविष्टानाम् of those seated on the banks of the Ganga, ऋषीणाम् of the sages, उग्रतेजसाम् of fierce ascetic power.
explanation: Sita said, "O Raghava, I desire to see the sacred hermitages and the sages of fierce ascetic power seated on the banks of the Ganga."

shloka_text: फलमूलाशिनां देव पादमूलेषु वर्तितुम् । एष मे परमः कामो यन्मूलफलभोजिनाम् ।। 7.42.34 ।।
transliteration: eṣa me paramaḥ kāmo yanmūlaphalabhojinām | apyekarātraṃ kākutstha nivaseyaṃ tapovane || 7.42.34 ||
translation: फलमूलाशिनाम् of those who subsist on fruits and roots, देव O Lord, पादमूलेषु at the feet, वर्तितुम् to dwell, एषः this, मे my, परमः greatest, कामः desire, यत् that, मूलफलभोजिनाम् of those who subsist on roots and fruits.
explanation: Sita continued, "O Lord, to dwell at the feet of those who subsist on fruits and roots—this is my greatest desire, that I may be among those who eat roots and fruits."

shloka_text: अप्येकरात्रं काकुत्स्थ निवसेयं तपोवने । तथेति च प्रतिज्ञातं रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । विस्रब्धा भव वैदेहि श्वो गमिष्यस्यसंशयम् ।। 7.42.35 ।।
transliteration: tatheti ca pratijñātaṃ rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā | visrabdhā bhava vaidehi śvo gamiṣyasyasaṃśayam || 7.42.35 ||
translation: अपि even, एकरात्रम् for one night, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, निवसेयम् I may dwell, तपोवने in a hermitage, तथा so be it, इति thus, च and, प्रतिज्ञातम् was promised, रामेण by Rama, अक्लिष्टकर्मणा whose deeds are unwearied, विस्रब्धा confident, भव be, वैदेहि O Vaidehi, श्वः tomorrow, गमिष्यसि you will go, असंशयम् without doubt.
explanation: Sita expressed her desire to dwell in a hermitage for even one night, to which Rama, whose deeds were effortless, promised, "So be it, O Vaidehi, be confident, you will undoubtedly go tomorrow."

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा तु काकुत्स्थो मैथिलीं जनकात्मजाम् । मध्यकक्षान्तरं रामो निर्जगाम सुहृद्वृतः ।। 7.42.36 ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu kākutstho maithilīṃ janakātmajām | madhyakakṣāntaraṃ rāmo nirjagāma suhṛdvṛtaḥ || 7.42.36 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, तु indeed, काकुत्स्थः Rama, मैथिलीम् to Maithili, जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter, मध्यकक्षान्तरम् to the middle apartment, रामः Rama, निर्जगाम went out, सुहृद्वृतः surrounded by friends.
explanation: After speaking thus to Sita, Janaka's daughter, Rama, surrounded by his friends, went out to the middle apartment. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्विचत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 42 ।। Thus ends the forty-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
